Living room southwest at end of hall has one balcony door/window unit on its outer wall. Small kitchen is opposite living room off short arm of hall, one small window. Windowless combined bathroom adjacent to kitchen shares wet wall. Furnishing vocabulary old medium-brown veneer, olive/burgundy small accents, practical mismatched late-Soviet furniture. Cozy cared-for but imperfect, not luxurious or uniformly decorated.
